exposure: Inflammatory bowel disease (Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, IBD-U)
cohort: 82 pregnancies in 77 women with a history of stoma formation due to inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) from 15 UK hospitals
finding: Pregnancy in women with a history of stoma formation due to IBD was associated with higher rates of cesarean section and stoma complications.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rate was 73% in pregnant women with stomas due to IBD.
